main.summary: Inspects and deletes persisted local transfer sessions under a client working-directory root.

field.name: storage
field.summary: Working-directory storage used to enumerate, load, and delete persisted transfer sessions.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a session manager over the provided working-directory options.
constructor.param: Working-directory options that define the local session root.

method.name: GetLocalSession
method.summary: Load a single persisted local transfer session by identifier.
method.returns: A task that completes with local session information, or null when the session is not present.

method.name: ListLocalSessions
method.summary: Enumerate all persisted local transfer sessions ordered by most recently updated first.
method.returns: A task that completes with the discovered local transfer sessions.

method.name: DeleteLocalSession
method.summary: Delete persisted artifacts for a local transfer session.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the session artifacts were deleted; otherwise false.
